segments.text: But the humble confession of al penitent hartes, theyr knowledgyng of Chrystes benefytes, their thanks giuing for the same, their faith and consolation in Christe, their humble submission and obedience to goddes wyll and commaundementes, is a sacrifice of laude & praise, accepted and alowed of god no lesse, then the sacrifyce of the priest. For almyghty god wythout respect of persone, accepteth the oblatyon and sacrifyce of priest & lay person, of kyng & subiect, of mayster and seruaunt, of man and woman, of yonge and olde, yea of English, French, Scot, Greek, Latine, Iewe and Gentyle, of euery mā accorig to his faithfull & obedient hart vnto him, and that through ye sacrifice propiciatory of Iesu Chryst.
